_about: Radios that RFI Trail can read over a USB/serial CAT cable. One entry per model. To add a radio of a family that is already supported, copy a similar entry and change the id, name, address / digits and the meter table. 'meter' is a list of [raw reading, dB relative to S9] pairs; readings between two pairs are joined by a straight line. Sources: the makers' CAT / CI-V reference manuals for the commands, and the open-source Hamlib project for the meter tables. 'verified' stays false until someone has checked the entry against the real radio.

dialects.icom_civ: Icom CI-V binary frames. Frequency: command 03 (read) / 05 (set). S-meter: command 15 02, two BCD digits pairs 0000-0255.
dialects.text_cat: Text commands ending in a semicolon (Kenwood, Elecraft, newer Yaesu). Frequency: FA; (read) / FAnnnnnnnnn; (set). S-meter: a short read command such as SM0;
dialects.flex_api: FlexRadio SmartSDR network API (calibrated dBm from the radio's own LEVEL meter)

models.name: IC-7300
models.source: Icom IC-7300 CI-V reference (0000=S0, 0120=S9, 0241=S9+60); Hamlib IC7300_STR_CAL
models.notes: In the radio: MENU > SET > Connectors > CI-V: set CI-V Address 94h, CI-V USB Port 'Unlink from [REMOTE]', and CI-V USB Baud Rate to match. Turn CI-V Transceive OFF.

models.name: IC-705
models.source: Icom IC-705 CI-V reference; Hamlib IC705_STR_CAL
models.notes: Set CI-V Address A4h, and CI-V Transceive OFF, in MENU > SET > Connectors.

models.name: IC-7610
models.source: Icom IC-7610 CI-V reference; Hamlib IC7610_STR_CAL
models.notes: CI-V Address 98h. Turn CI-V Transceive OFF.

models.name: IC-9700 (VHF/UHF)
models.source: Icom IC-9700 CI-V reference (0000=S0, 0120=S9, 0241=S9+60 only; straight line between)
models.notes: CI-V Address A2h. Reads the main receiver.

models.name: IC-7100
models.source: Icom CI-V reference (S0 / S9 / S9+60 points only); default address from Hamlib
models.notes: CI-V Address 88h.

models.name: IC-7600
models.source: Icom CI-V reference (S0 / S9 / S9+60 points only); default address from Hamlib
models.notes: CI-V Address 7Ah.

models.name: FT-991 / FT-991A
models.source: Yaesu FT-991A CAT Operation Reference (FA, SM0); Hamlib FT991_STR_CAL
models.notes: The baud rate must match MENU 031 CAT RATE in the radio (the factory setting is 4800).

models.name: FT-891
models.source: Yaesu FT-891 CAT Operation Reference Book; Hamlib FT891_STR_CAL
models.notes: The baud rate must match the CAT RATE menu in the radio.

models.name: FT-710
models.source: Yaesu FT-710 CAT manual; Hamlib FT710_STR_CAL
models.notes: The baud rate must match the CAT RATE menu in the radio.

models.name: FTDX10
models.source: Yaesu FTDX10 CAT Operation Reference; Hamlib default Yaesu table
models.notes: The baud rate must match the CAT RATE menu in the radio.

models.name: FTDX101D / FTDX101MP
models.source: Yaesu FTDX101 CAT Operation Reference; Hamlib FTDX101D_STR_CAL
models.notes: Reads the MAIN receiver. The baud rate must match the CAT RATE menu.

models.name: FT-450 / FT-450D
models.source: Yaesu FT-450 CAT reference; Hamlib FT450_STR_CAL (three points)
models.notes: Older Yaesu models use 8 digits in the frequency command. The baud rate must match the CAT RATE menu.

models.name: TS-590S / TS-590SG
models.source: Kenwood TS-590S / TS-590SG PC Control Command Reference (FA, SM0 reads 0000-0030); Hamlib TS590_STR_CAL
models.notes: Over USB the baud rate in the program must match the radio's menu setting for the virtual COM port.

models.name: TS-890S
models.source: Kenwood TS-890S PC Command Reference; Hamlib TS-890S IARU meter table
models.notes: Uses the IARU (6 dB per S-unit) scale. Set the radio's S-meter type to match if you change it.

models.name: TS-480
models.source: Kenwood TS-480 command reference; Hamlib TS480_STR_CAL
models.notes: Check the baud rate in the radio's menu.

models.name: TS-2000
models.source: Kenwood TS-2000 command reference; Hamlib TS2000_STR_CAL
models.notes: Check the baud rate in the radio's menu.

models.name: TS-990S
models.source: Kenwood TS-990S PC Control Command Reference; Hamlib TS990S_STR_CAL
models.notes: Reads the main receiver.

models.name: K3 / K3S (firmware 4.37 or newer)
models.source: Elecraft K3S/K3/KX3/KX2 Programmer's Reference (FA, SMH high-resolution meter); Hamlib K3_SMH_CAL
models.notes: Set the radio's RS232 baud rate (CONFIG:RS232) to match.

models.name: KX3 / KX2 / older K3
models.source: Elecraft K3S/K3/KX3/KX2 Programmer's Reference (SM); Hamlib K3_SM_CAL
models.notes: Coarse meter (16 steps). Set the radio's RS232 baud rate to match.

models.name: FLEX-6300
models.source: FlexRadio SmartSDR API (TCP 4992, slice and meter status, LEVEL meter in dBm over UDP)
models.notes: No SmartSDR needed in Control mode: the program makes its own panadapter and slice, tunes it, and removes both when it closes. Follow mode only reads a slice that SmartSDR (or another program) already has open. The radio and this computer must be on the same network; allow RFI Trail / Python through the firewall (meters arrive by UDP).
